Avik Anwar (Bengali: অভিক আনোয়ার; born: 4 September 1986) is a Bangladeshi professional racing driver and automotive content creator.
Career
Avik Anwar began his racing career by winning the Bangladesh Rallycross Championship three years in a row from 2014 to 2016. In 2019, he became the first Bangladeshi to win an international motorsport event, securing victory in the Volkswagen Ameo Cup in India.
In 2022, Anwar made history by winning the NGK Pro Car Championship in the United Arab Emirates, finishing the season with a dominant lead after multiple wins at the Dubai Autodrome and Yas Marina Circuit. He continued his success in 2023 with a podium finish and race win in the Malaysia Championship Series at Sepang International Circuit.
Despite a rib injury, he returned in 2024 to win back-to-back races in the Gulf Pro Car Championship in Dubai.
Outside racing, Anwar is managing director of Car House Imports and Director of the Car House Limited. He also serves as a brand ambassador for Meghna Group of Industries (MGI) and Caltex Lubricants.
In July 2025, Avik Anwar was injured in a high-speed crash during a race at Malaysia's Sepang International Circuit. He suffered a concussion, rib and foot injuries, and was hospitalized in Cyberjaya.
Personal life
Avik was born on 4 September 1986 in Munshiganj, Dhaka, Bangladesh. He is married to Armani Mahwish Naomi  in 2021.
Awards and Achievement
* Bangladesh Rallycross Champion – 2014, 2015, 2016
* Volkswagen Ameo Cup (India) – First Bangladeshi race winner, 2019
* First Bangladeshi to win on a Formula One circuit (Yas Marina, 2021)
* NGK Pro Car Championship (UAE) – Champion, 2022
* Malaysia Championship Series (Sepang) – Race winner, 2023
* Gulf Pro Car Championship (UAE) – Double race winner, 2024
* Brand Ambassador, Meghna Group of Industries and Caltex Lubricants
* Recognized as Bangladesh's first international motorsport champion
